paraphrase: Debate among the learned is of three kinds — vāda, jalpa and vitaṇḍā; (vāda) aims solely at determining the truth, as between teacher and disciple.

original.text: vādo jalpo vitaṇḍeti trividhā viduṣāṃ kathā | tattvanirṇayam uddiśya kevalaṃ guruśiṣyayoḥ ||2||
original.edition: sanskrit/raw_etexts (GitHub) Devanāgarī e-text; transliterated to IAST for this entry

speaker: Madhva
